name: CaseGridExplicitAnchor
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-explicit-anchor" (grid-placement). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: grid-row: 3; grid-column: 2 (explicit cell placement, 0-based contract / 1-based CSS)
